$description: Appearance-invariant base tokens and WinUI 3 style overrides (Segoe UI Variable, Consolas, double focus rings, timing motion).

designMd.overview: WinUI 3 / Fluent 2 (`winui3/release/2.7.0`): Windows 11 fill and stroke resources composited over `SolidBackgroundFillColorBase` (`#F3F3F3` light / `#202020` dark) with `#0078D4` accent, `Segoe UI Variable` + `Consolas`, double focus strokes, and deterministic timing curves.
designMd.elevation: WinUI 3 ThemeShadow depths (2/8/16/32/128) paired with composited `ControlStrokeColorDefault` / `SurfaceStrokeColorDefault` borders and `material.windows` blur on `glass`, `menu`, and `tooltip` (`AcrylicInAppFillColorDefault` 0.85 light / 0.96 dark).
dos: Use `4px` `ControlCornerRadius` for controls/fields/chips/insets and `8px` `OverlayCornerRadius` for cards/overlays/dialogs/sheets with `shape.curve: "circular"`.
Use `focus.style: "double"` (2px outer `FocusStrokeColorOuter` + 1px inner `FocusStrokeColorInner`) and WinUI timing motion (`decelerate` / `point-to-point`).
Use `indicator` `underline` tabs/fields and leading `bar` navigation indicators with `Segoe UI Variable` (`{font.family.sans}`).
donts: Do not substitute continuous squircle corners or spring physics for WinUI 3's circular corners and timing curves.

radius.$description: WinUI 3 corner radius scale: ControlCornerRadius 4px (controls/fields/chips/insets) and OverlayCornerRadius 8px (cards/overlays/dialogs/sheets).

base.$description: Base corner radius shared by insets and general rounded elements.

card.$description: Corner radius for cards and sidebar floating containers.

control.$description: Corner radius for interactive controls such as buttons, triggers, and menu items.

field.$description: Corner radius for form input fields and editor wells.

chip.$description: Corner radius for badges, chips, and compact tags.

overlay.$description: Corner radius for floating menus, popovers, and toasts.

sheet.$description: Corner radius for drawers and bottom sheets.

indicator.$description: 3px active navigation/tab indicator width per WinUI 3.

focus.$description: WinUI 3 double focus stroke (2px outer FocusStrokeColorOuter + 1px inner FocusStrokeColorInner, 0px offset).

width.$description: 2px outer focus stroke width per WinUI 3.

checkbox.$description: WinUI 3 CheckBox resting ControlAltFillColorSecondary interior with 1px ControlStrongStrokeColorDefault border (CheckBox_themeresources.xaml in winui3/release/2.7.0).

sans.$description: WinUI 3 primary UI font stack (Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; typography.md).

typography.$description: WinUI 3 typography scale mapped from TextBlock_themeresources.xaml (400 and 600 weights only).

caption.$description: Small captions and segmented counter labels.

detail.$description: Sidebar section labels, counts, and supporting metadata.

body.$description: Standard body copy, list rows, and dialog content.

label.$description: Control labels, form labels, and interactive triggers.

display.$description: Large display numerals and hero headings.

shape.$description: Circular corner curve (WinUI 3 has no continuous squircle curve; geometry.md).

color.$description: Appearance-invariant C-layer color roles shared by light and dark modes.

brand-fill.$description: Primary brand action fill, aliased to {color.primary} (WinUI AccentFillColorDefault).

on-brand.$description: Foreground text and icons on brand-fill surfaces, aliased to {color.primary-foreground} (WinUI TextOnAccentFillColorPrimary).

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind dialogs and overlays (WinUI SmokeFillColorDefault #4D000000).

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

chart-foreground.$description: Dark ink on light chart tiles matching WinUI light TextFillColorPrimary.

window-close.$description: macOS window close traffic-light button fill.

window-minimize.$description: macOS window minimize traffic-light button fill.

window-zoom.$description: macOS window zoom traffic-light button fill.

window-control-ink.$description: Glyph ink inside macOS window traffic-light buttons (50% black literal).

window-control-edge.$description: Hairline border around macOS window traffic-light buttons (12% black literal).

state.$description: Interaction state opacities, press scale, and ripple switch.

press-scale.$description: Scale factor applied while pressed (1 disables press shrinking; WinUI 3 swaps fill brushes instead).

pressed-opacity.$description: Content stays full opacity when pressed (1; fill brush swap shows press).

accent-pressed-opacity.$description: Pressed opacity for accent controls when no pressed accent finish replaces it.

disabled.$description: WinUI 3 disabled styling: 0.36 TextFillColorDisabled content with fill: true container override.

enter.$description: WinUI 3 250ms entrance transition with Direct Entrance decelerate curve (motion.md).

motion.$description: Interactive spring and timing physics roles.

press.$description: WinUI 3 ToggleSwitch press timing (83ms decelerate, ToggleSwitch_themeresources.xaml:321).

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for press.

settle.$description: WinUI 3 250ms settle timing with Direct Entrance decelerate curve.

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for settle.

control.$description: WinUI 3 167ms control timing with Point-to-Point curve.

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for control.

move.$description: WinUI 3 333ms move timing with Point-to-Point curve.

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for move.

indicator.$description: WinUI 3 underlined tabs, NavigationView leading bar, and bottom-underlined text fields.
